from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReportRiskReserve(BaseModel):
    """General risk reserve data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the report")
    company_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/certificate code if mentioned")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this document")
    general_risk_reserve_begin: float | None = Field(description="Beginning balance of general risk reserve, if reported")
    general_risk_reserve_end: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of general risk reserve, if reported")
    is_target_company: bool = Field(description="Whether this is 格力电器 (Gree Electric) based on company name")
    quote: str = Field(description="Excerpt from the document showing the risk reserve data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    risk_reserves: list[FinancialReportRiskReserve]
